description: Guia de calles de Sentmenat is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sentmenat.cat. The Sentmenat Township Street Guide consists of a viewfinder on an OpenStreetMap cartographic background. The map contains several interest points and for each point the name of the place or establishment, postal address, external links and images, if applicable, interactively displayed. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Sentmenat Street Guide" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include street guide, guia de carrers, guía de calles, Sentmenat. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
